The current layout consists of a double reception and un-extended kitchen, leading to the private garden. The first floor consists of two double bedrooms, family bathroom and additional WC, with addition un-touched loft storage. This property presents a fantastic opportunity for someone looking to put their own stamp on their next home. Mendora Road is a peaceful residential street in central Fulham. Situated close to Normand Park, Virgin Active Fitness Centre and bus routes on Lillie Road. West Brompton underground and overground station is 0.8 miles away and Barons Court underground station is 0.9 miles.
